title: Single-cell ScarTrace
protocol: Add 5 μl of mineral oil per well using a multichannel pipette.
Dispense 50 nl of 7.5 ng/μl CEL-seq2 primers per well using the Mosquito.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C.
Spike in 0.02 μl per well at a dilution of 1:50,000.
Add 0.01 μl per well of dNTP 10mM to the master mix.
Add 0.01 μl per well of SUPERase-in to the master mix.
Add 0.01 μl per well of H2O to the master mix.
Pipette 13.8 μl of master mix into each tube of a PCR 8-tube strip.
Dispense 50 nl of master mix per well using the Nanodrop II.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C and keep on ice.
Sort single cells into plates containing primers, Spike in, dNTP, and Superase-in.
Cover sorted plates with silver sealer aluminum.
Spin down the covered plates for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C.
Snap freeze the sorted plates on dry ice.
Store the snap-frozen plates at -80°C.
Before lysis, make the RT master mix as follows: add 0.035 μl per well of 5x First Strand Buffer.
Add 0.0175 μl per well of 0.1M DTT to the RT master mix.
Add 0.005 μl per well of H2O to the RT master mix.
Pipette 15.5 µl of RT master mix into each tube of a PCR 8-tube strip.
Keep the tubes on ice.
Lyse cells at 65°C for 5 minutes in a 384 well Thermocycler.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C and cool on ice.
Place the strip in the correct location for dispensing in the Nanodrop II.
Dispense 75 nl of the RT mix.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C.
Incubate at 42°C for 1 hour then at 70°C for 10 minutes in a 384 well Thermocycler, keeping the lid open.
Cool on ice.
Make a second strand master mix as follows: Add H2O, 2nd strand buffer 5x, dNTP 10mM, E.coli ligase, E.coli DNA polymerase I, and RNAse H in appropriate volumes for two plates.
Pipette 101 µl of second strand master mix into each tube of a PCR 8-tube strip.
Place the strip in the correct location for dispensing in the Nanodrop II.
Dispense 960 nl of the master mix.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C.
Incubate at 16°C for 2 hours in a 384 well Thermocycler, keeping the lid open.
Mix 60 µl of Proteinase K with 90 µl H2O to make a 1:2,5 dilution.
Pipette 18.6 µl of the diluted Proteinase K into each tube of a PCR 8-tube strip.
Place the strip in the correct location for dispensing in the Nanodrop II and dispense 100 nl of the diluted Proteinase K.
Incubate the strip at 55 °C for 1 hour in a 384 well Thermocycler.
Heat inactivate the mixture at 80°C for 10 minutes.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C and cool on ice.
Make a PCR I master mix as follows: Add 20.6 µl of Primer eGFP-F1 (10 µM) to the mixture.
Add 20.6 µl of Primer eGFP-R1 (10 µM) to the mixture.
Add 1030 µl of NEBNext® High-Fidelity 2X PCR Master Mix to the mixture.
Pipette 133.8 µl of the master mix into each tube of a PCR 8-tube strip.
Dispense 1300 nl of the PCR I master mix using the Nanodrop II.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C.
Run PCR program: Start with denaturation at 98 °C for 1 min, followed by 8-10 cycles of denaturation at 98 °C for 10 sec, annealing at 58 °C for 30 sec, and extension at 72 °C for 30 sec.
Hold the final product at 4°C after a final extension at 72 °C for 10 min.
Dispense 75 nl of 10 µM eGFP-F2_BC_5 using the Mosquito.
Make a PCR II master mix as follows: Add 70.59 µl of eGFP-R2_3 (10 µM) to the mixture.
Add 235.29 µl of NEBNext® High-Fidelity 2X PCR Master Mix to the mixture.
Add 94.12 µl of H2O to the mixture.
Pipette 49.8 µl of master mix into each tube of a PCR 8-tube strip.
Place the strip in the correct location for dispensing in the Nanodrop II.
Dispense 425 nl of PCR II mix.
Spin down the dispensed plate for 1 minute at 2000x g at 4°C.
Warm AMPure XP beads to room temperature.
Pool all the wells from 1 plate by centrifuging each plate upside down into a separate container at 200g for 1 minute.
Collect the aqueous phase from the container and transfer into a 2 ml tube.
Wash the container with 1 ml mineral oil, collect and transfer into the same 2 ml tube.
Spin down the 2 ml tubes at maximum speed for 1 minute to separate the aqueous phase from the mineral oil.
Collect the aqueous phase without collecting any mineral oil and transfer to a clean 1.5 ml tube.
Measure how much was recovered in the 1.5 ml tube with a pipette.
Add 1x volume of mixed diluted AMPure XP beads (1:8 diluted with bead binding buffer).
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate on magnet stand for 5 minutes or until liquid is clear.
Remove supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Wash pellet carefully with 1 ml 80% Ethanol.
Incubate for at least 30 seconds.
Repeat above step.
Remove as much ethanol as possible.
Dry at room temperature for approximately 10 minutes or until dry.
Resuspend with 8 μl of water.
Pipette the entire volume up and down ten times to mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes until the liquid appears clear.
Transfer 8 μl of supernatant to a new tube.
Transfer 1.6 µl of the sample for SCAR library (20%).
Transfer 6.4 µl of the sample for transcriptome library (80%).
Add 8.4 μl of H2O to 1.6 μl of samples.
Add 2 μl EXOSAP-IT.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes then at 80 °C for 15 minutes.
Prewarm beads to room temperature.
Vortex AMPure XP Beads until well dispersed, then add 12 μl of beads to the 12 μl sample (1:1 ratio).
Mix the entire volume up ten times to mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Place on a magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes until the liquid appears clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% Ethanol.
Incubate for at least 30 seconds, then remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing beads.
Add another 200 μl of freshly prepared 80% Ethanol.
Incubate for at least 30 seconds, then remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing beads.
Air dry beads for 15 minutes or until completely dry.
Resuspend with 10 μl of water.
Pipette the entire volume up and down ten times to mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes until the liquid appears clear.
Transfer 10 μl of supernatant to a new tube.
Add 38 μl of the following mix: Ultra Pure Water (11 μl), NEBNext® High-Fidelity 2X PCR Master Mix (25 μl), RNA PCR Primer (RP1) (2 μl).
To each reaction, add 2 μl of a uniquely indexed RNA PCR Primer.

Amplify the tube in the thermal cycler with 30 seconds at 98°C followed by 10-14 cycles of: 10 seconds at 98°C, 30 seconds at 60°C, and 30 seconds at 72°C. Final step is 10 minutes at 72°C, then hold at 4°C.
Prewarm beads to room temperature.
Vortex AMPure XP Beads until well dispersed, then add 40 μl to the 50 μl PCR reaction and mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Place on magnetic stand for at least 5 min until liquid appears clear.
Remove and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 μl freshly prepared 80% Ethanol, incubate at least 30 seconds, then remove and discard supernatant without disturbing beads.
Repeat with another addition of 200 μl freshly prepared 80% Ethanol, incubate for at least 30 seconds, then remove and discard supernatant without disturbing beads.
Air dry beads for 15 min until completely dry.
Resuspend with 25 μl water and pipette up and down ten times to mix thoroughly.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 min.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 min until liquid appears clear.
Transfer 25 μl of supernatant to a new tube.
Repeat bead cleanup by adding 22.5 μl beads.
Elute in 11 μl water at the end.
Transfer 10 μl to a new tube.
Check DNA concentration using Qubit with 1 μl of sample and high sensitivity reagent.
Expect a minimum concentration of ~1 ng/μl.
Run 1 μl of each sample on Bioanalyzer using a high sensitivity DNA chip.
Analyze size distribution.
